QUOTE: "with the shipped defaults, mbedtls creates no threads and takes no mutexes." and "The index found four spawn sites, all in `programs/`" and "`programs/ssl/ssl_pthread_server.c:277`: one `handle_ssl_connection` thread per client. This program needs `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (guard at line 24)."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads by default, but it never states that the pthread example compiles to a stub main under a default build. It only says the program needs those options, and it lists the program as a spawn site.
